ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the core source of food in this food web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram labels trees, grass, deer, mouse, cricket, frog, owl, snake, hawk, and decomposers. The arrows show links among them; visible plant-source arrows include trees feeding deer and grass feeding mouse and cricket. Reasoning: Using the food-web convention that arrows show food or energy moving from what is eaten to the eater, the organisms at the base that feed consumers but are not shown eating other organisms are the plants. In this diagram, those plant sources are trees and grass, so they are the core source of food in the web.
